summary: End-to-end backend verification of Telegram notifications for Sollmarine. All 10 pytest cases PASSED. GET /api/ returns telegram_configured:true. POST /api/telegram/test returns {sent:true} — confirms bot token 8904658946:... and chat_id 5360342685 are valid and Telegram accepts messages. POST /api/reservations and POST /api/orders return 200, persist data in MongoDB, and each triggers a background httpx POST to https://api.telegram.org/bot.../sendMessage that responds with HTTP/1.1 200 OK (confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log at 05:17-05:18 UTC 2026-09-19). No 'Telegram API error', 'Telegram send failed', or 'Telegram not configured' log lines in the current test run. Conclusion: сообщения в Telegram доставляются админу при каждой брони и каждом заказе.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses payload.dict() which is deprecated in Pydantic v2 — should migrate to payload.model_dump(). Non-blocking, still functional.
app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI — should migrate to lifespan context manager. Non-blocking.
CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router; that still works in Starlette but conventionally middleware is added before mounting routers.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is logged in cleartext by httpx INFO logging (as part of the request URL). Consider logging.getLogger('httpx').setLevel(logging.WARNING) to avoid leaking the token in supervisor logs.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ reservation and 1 TEST_ order in MongoDB during the test run (records left intact to keep evidence of the Telegram notifications sent to admin chat 5360342685).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_telegram_flow.py covers: health, /api/telegram/test, reservation+order CRUD-lite, and log scanning restricted to the CURRENT run (RUN_START_TS filter) — safe to re-run without false positives from historical log entries. Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug. User's question was 'приходит ли сообщение в тг с сайта'. Answer: YES. Evidence: 3 successful httpx POSTs to api.telegram.org/bot<token>/sendMessage returning HTTP/1.1 200 OK during current test run (one for /api/telegram/test, one for reservation background task, one for order background task). Telegram accepts and delivers each message to chat_id 5360342685.
